name: gemini-advisor
description: Dynamic frontier-to-execution routing for Antigravity: apex Frontier models (Gemini 4 Argon) plan and audit in read-only mode, while fast and economical models (Gemini Flash / Flash-Lite) execute code.

interface.shortDescription: Dynamic Frontier model allocation for planning and audit, Flash for execution.
interface.longDescription: Gemini Advisor is a capability-routed software delivery plugin for Antigravity. It dynamically checks and allocates the most advanced Frontier model (currently Gemini 4 Argon, and automatically any future apex model) for thinking, planning, and fresh read-only auditing, while delegating code execution to faster, cheaper models (Gemini Flash and Gemini Flash-Lite).
